sources.title: ai-models/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B · Cloud Native Build
sources.snippet: This repository also includes our I2V-A14B model, designed for image-to-video generation, supporting both 480P and 720P resolutions. Built with a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, it achieves more stable video synthesis with reduced unrealistic camera movements and offers enhanced support for diverse stylized scenes.
